Service.Name: CertificateOfMailing
Service.Hint: Provides evidence that mail has been presented to the Post Office for mailing. Does not provide a record of delivery.

Service.Name: Certified
Service.Hint: Provides verification that an article was delivered or that a delivery attempt was made.

Service.Name: DeliveryConfirmation
Service.Hint: Provides information about the date and time an article was delivered and, if delivery was attempted but not successful, the date and time of the delivery attempt. No record is kept at the office of mailing.

Service.Name: ExpressDomesticInsurance
Service.Hint: Express mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Maximum is $5000.

Service.Name: ExpressInternationalInsurance
Service.Hint: Express Mail International items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Maximum depends on destination.

Service.Name: GlobalExpressGuaranteedInsurance
Service.Hint: Global Express Guaranteed mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Maximum depends on destination.

Service.Name: Insurance
Service.Hint: Items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Maximum insured amount is $5000.

Service.Name: DomesticInsurance
Service.Hint: First Class, Priority and Parcel Post mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Insurance under $200 does not allow a return receipt. (Delivery Confirmation is available.) Maximum is $5000.

Service.Name: PriorityMailInternationalInsurance
Service.Hint: Priority Mail International mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Maximum depends on destination.

Service.Name: Registered
Service.Hint: The most secure service that the Post Office offers. Only matter prepaid with postage at the First-Class Mail rates (including Priority Mail) may be registered.

Service.Name: RestrictedDelivery
Service.Hint: Permits sender to direct delivery only to the addressee or addressee's authorized agent. The addressee must be an individual (or natural person) specified by name.

Service.Name: ReturnReceipt
Service.Hint: Provides evidence of delivery (to whom the mail was delivered and date of delivery), along with information about the recipient's actual delivery address.

Service.Name: SignatureConfirmation
Service.Hint: Provides the date and time an article was delivered and, if delivery was attempted but not successful, the date and time of the delivery attempt.
Service.Caption: Signature Confirmation
